COPY_NEW.title: New copy, same structure
COPY_NEW.desc: A new script modeled on this format: same blocks, timing and angle.

keep.desc: Each variation lives inside the winner’s own video: same layout, panels, captions, headline and audio. Only the lever changes.

keep.needChoice: Remove the blocked kind or choose a clean talking head
keep.swapNote: The new face takes the winner’s place in every frame it appears in, speaking the original audio in one continuous take.
keep.hooksNote: Only the hook text changes, on the winner’s own video. Speech, cuts and captions stay; the winner itself is the control.

reason.not_mapped: This winner was analyzed before the edit could be mapped. Analyze it again.
reason.no_face: No face found in the video
reason.multiple_faces: Two or more faces on screen
reason.low_confidence: The face is too hard to track (dark, small or turned away)

keep.estimateNote: Keeps the winner’s edit: original audio, same format ({format}) and size. Nothing to set here.
keep.noteSwap: One continuous lipsync take of the original audio ({s} s), new face over the winner’s edit.
keep.noteHooks: Text redrawn on the winner’s video. No generation cost.

keep.hooksSub: New text for the first seconds, on the winner’s own video. The speech stays the original. Nothing is generated until the Estimate.

keep.noteSwapVideoB: {engine} speaks the copy with its own voice per stretch ({s} s generated), fitted to the winner’s timing.

cast.title: Cast

desc.DIVERSE: Each variation brings a person clearly different from the others and from the original: ethnicity, age, hair, eyes, tattoos, piercings and style vary. Lighting, framing and pose follow the original.
desc.MATCH_ORIGINAL: Another person with the same profile as whoever appears in the original.

cast.genderNote: When swapping the avatar on the original audio, the new person’s gender follows the voice.
cast.replanNote: Changing the cast after the plan rewrites this batch’s plan.
cast.replanTitle: Changing the cast rewrites the plan
cast.replanBody: Who appears in each variation is written again, and the faces already generated for this batch are discarded.
cast.replanBodyHooks: Who appears and the hooks are written again, and the faces already generated for this batch are discarded.

swap.title: Engine for Swap the avatar
swap.sub: Same edit, same length as the winner. Prices side by side; pick the engine and the audio.

trade.LIPSYNC: Cheapest and fastest. Only the mouth moves over the new face.
trade.KLING: Natural head and hand movement, sharpest image. Costs several times more.
trade.SEEDANCE: Natural movement, a bit cheaper than Kling. Resolution follows the face area.

why.lipsyncOnly: Lipsync only uses the original audio. Pick Kling or Seedance to use the engine’s voice.
why.needsKeep: Only when keeping the winner’s edit. Start a new batch with it on.
why.notEnabled: Coming soon: we’re still testing that the engine keeps the same voice across stretches.
why.blocked: This winner’s edit can’t take the engine’s voice:
why.klingVoice: Kling’s voice changes between stretches — use Original audio.

explain.LIPSYNC: One continuous lipsync take of the winner’s audio over the new face. Edit, length and audio identical to the winner.
explain.A: {engine} animates the new face without sound, stretch by stretch, then lipsync puts the winner’s own audio on it. Edit, length and audio identical to the winner.
explain.B: {engine} speaks the copy with its own voice. We fit it to the winner’s timing (up to 8%) and redraw the captions with the new words. The length doesn’t change.

warning.voice_may_vary: The engine may change the voice a little between stretches.
warning.music_bed_drops: The winner has music under the speech; it drops out in the swapped stretches.
warning.short_segment_padded: A stretch is shorter than the engine’s minimum (Kling 3 s, Seedance 4 s); you pay the minimum.

lock.burnt_no_background: This text is burned into the winner's video, with no solid background, outside the face area. The original can't be erased, so it can't be changed.
lock.outside_redrawn_interval: Outside the redrawn stretches this is the winner's original.

gate.notReadyTitle: The editor opens when the scenes are ready
gate.notReadyBody: It needs every scene generated, and it is closed after the Final OK.

entry.title: Edit on the video
entry.body: Move, resize and rotate hook, captions and CTA. Change when each text starts and ends, fix caption words, trim, reorder and delete scenes.
entry.alsoReview: Also available in the Final OK.
entry.unavailable: Opens when every scene is ready.
entry.bannerTitle: Editor changes are not in the video yet
entry.bannerBody: They are saved. Export to update the video before the Final OK.
entry.capPosEditor: Set in the editor. Picking one here replaces the caption position from the editor.
entry.tplBody: Layers go back to the new template's positions. Text, timing, cuts, deleted scenes and word fixes stay, and the style you changed stays on top of the new look.
entry.swapped: Template switched. Layers are back in the template positions.
entry.editedTip: Exported with editor changes. A variation edited this way differs from the control in more than one thing.

rule.video_too_short: the video is shorter than 1 s.
rule.clip_too_short: a scene is shorter than 0.3 s.
rule.clips_must_cover_scenes: the scene list is out of date. Reload the editor.
rule.unknown_scene: a scene no longer exists. Reload the editor.
rule.trim_out_of_range: a cut is outside its scene.
rule.unknown_font: a font is not in the catalog.
rule.doc_too_large: too many changes in one video (or a text over 300 characters).
rule.unknown_word: a fixed word no longer exists.

campaigns.heading: Campaigns reads {client}'s Meta results every day.
campaigns.promise: It shows cost per purchase against the target and ranks hooks, bodies and CTAs by real numbers. It needs the Meta connection, which isn't built yet.

eddy.heading: Eddy reads the results and tells you what to make next.
eddy.promise: Plain-language notes on what's tiring, what's missing and what works, plus proposals you approve. It needs the Meta connection, which isn't built yet.

brain.heading: Brain keeps everything HookMill knows about {client}.
brain.promise: Business, offer, audience, proof and the rules every run follows, with how complete it is. This screen arrives in the next round. Today your offers hold this.

clients.heading: All your clients in one place.
clients.promise: Each client with its status, setup progress and what's waiting on you. This screen arrives in the next round. Today you switch clients from the selector at the top of the menu.

preview.note1: Your best ad went from $19.40 to $26.80 per purchase as people saw it 3.4 times.
preview.note2: Hooks that open on the problem cost 22% less per purchase than hooks that open on the product.
preview.note3: No ad talks to people who already tried a cheap mask and gave up.

flow.soonStep: Coming soon. Today the flow uses one concept: the offer you picked.

offer.title: Product & offer
offer.desc: What we sell and why it sells

audience.title: Audience & voice
audience.desc: Who buys and how we talk

business.title: Tell us about the business
business.sub: Start with the website. We read it to fill the offer, so the next steps are mostly checking what we found.
business.readHint: Reading takes about 20 seconds. It fills only empty fields of the offer, never what you typed.
business.saving: Saving what we found to the offer…
business.readDone: Read the site. You'll check what we found in steps 3 and 4.
business.readEmpty: Read the site, but found nothing new for the offer. Fill it in step 3.
business.name: Business name
business.typeLegend: What kind of business is it?
business.typeHint: This sets what counts as a result in step 5: purchases for an online store (digital products too), leads for a local business, installs for an app.
business.codeHint: 2 to 6 letters or digits. It starts every video file name, so results can be matched later.
business.codeInvalid: Use 2 to 6 letters or digits, no spaces.
business.soonCurrency: Currency and time zone per client arrive with the Meta connection.
business.teamSub: Who can see this client. The client approves ads; they can't spend or change settings.
business.fixFirst: Check the name and the client code.

meta.title: Connect {name}'s Meta account
meta.sub: The client logs in with Meta and gives HookMill access to the ad account, Page and pixel.
meta.heading: Meta comes in a later round.
meta.promise: It will read campaigns and results every day and create ads only after approval. It needs the Meta connection, which isn't built yet. Skip it for now: everything else works without it.
meta.hint: You can connect Meta later, when it's ready.

preview.loginSub: Pick the business, ad account, Page and pixel.
preview.can3: Pause ads, never above the spend ceiling

offer.title: What are we selling?
offer.sub: Fill the offer for {name}. All of it goes into the Brain and every script is written from it.
offer.subRead: We found this on {site}. Check it, fix anything that's off. All of it goes into {name}'s Brain.
offer.noOffer: No offer yet. Read the site in step 1 to fill it, or write it here.
offer.many: This client has {count} offers. Here you edit the most recent one; the others are in Offers.
offer.proofTitle: Proof we can use in ads
offer.proofHint: Reviews, numbers, guarantees, results. Only what's true.
offer.soonProducts: Products: the list from the site, with what to advertise and what to upsell.
offer.soonWhy: Why people buy, in their words, pulled from the reviews.
offer.soonObjections: Objections and answers from the FAQ, used in ad bodies.
offer.needsName: Give the offer a name to save it.

audience.title: Who buys, and how {name} talks
audience.sub: Scripts are written for these people and follow these instructions.
audience.noOffer: These fields belong to the offer. Add the offer in step 3 first.
audience.notesPh: e.g. Never promise results in days. Don't mention competitors by name.
audience.notesHint: Every script follows these. It shows in the Brain as Custom instructions.
audience.soonGroups: Buyer groups with what each one wants.
audience.soonVoice: Voice sliders and a line that sounds like the brand.
audience.soonBrand: Brand kit: logo, colors, fonts and the footage folder.

goals.title: Goals and guardrails
goals.sub: The spend cap is the one guardrail that works today: no generation goes past it this month.
goals.resultMissing: Pick the business type to set it.
goals.capHint: Images, voices and videos for this client stop at this amount each month. Empty = no cap.
goals.soonTargets: Targets and budget (cost per result, test budget, daily ceiling) need Meta results.
goals.soonApprovals: Approvals: what needs a yes before going live.
goals.soonAutonomy: How much Eddy can do on his own.

brain.title: Building {name}'s Brain
brain.sub: Everything HookMill knows about this client, from the steps you filled. Every script uses it.
brain.liveBody: Setup is done. Make the first ads below, or go to Home.
brain.liveHint: You can come back to any step to change it.

gate.businessType: Pick the business type in step 1.

brain.missingCount: {count, plural, one {# item missing} other {# items missing}}. The more it knows, the better the scripts.
brain.soonRead: Eddy's first read of 90 days of ads needs the Meta connection.
brain.start: Where do you want to start?
brain.iterateBody: Upload an ad that already works and make fresh versions of it.
brain.conceptsBody: Write scripts from the offer and make an ad from scratch.

signup.name: Your name

landing.metaTitle: HookMill · Video ads for any offer
landing.metaDescription: Iterate a winning ad into new faces and hooks, or go from an offer to an approved MP4. Built for agencies with many clients.

hero.titleB: made from the ones that already sell.
hero.sub: Upload a winning ad and get new faces and hooks in one batch. Or start from the offer and go from script to an approved MP4. Each client keeps a Brain, so every script starts from what you already know.
hero.note: English and Portuguese. Works on your phone.

panel.label: This batch
panel.winnerNote: Broken down into hook, body and CTA
panel.foot: Each one goes to Review. Approved ones land in the Library under this name.

paths.title: Two ways in. Both end in a file you approved.

iterate.title: Iterate a winner
iterate.sub: You already have an ad that sells. Keep what works and change one thing at a time.

steps.d: The MP4 of the ad that's working.
Hook, body, CTA and why it holds attention, read from the video.
Pick new faces, new hooks, or both. A control with the original hook comes along.
What the batch costs, before anything runs.
Every variation at once. See each one's real step.
Approve, retry or drop each one, then download.

scratch.title: New concepts
scratch.sub: No winner yet, or a new offer. Start from the brief and make the ad step by step.

steps.d: Paste the sales page link or fill the brief by hand.
Written from the client's Brain. Edit any line.
Pick who speaks, or generate new options.
Scenes with native audio, or avatar with voice and lipsync. Cost shows here.
Scene by scene, with progress you can leave and come back to.
Template, captions, hook text and CTA, or open the full video editor.
Final OK, then download the MP4.

bento.title: The parts that save you a week per client.

brain.title: A Brain for each client
brain.body: Business, offer, audience, proof and your custom instructions, in one place. Every script is written from it. Mark the ads that win and new scripts for the same offer learn from them.

names.title: Files named for the ad account
names.body: Every approved MP4 gets a standard name, so results match the creative later.

wait.title: Waiting you can read
wait.body: The real step, how many are done and what's left. Close the tab and come back; it keeps going.

editor.title: A real editor when the template isn't enough
editor.body: Trim clips, move captions word by word, swap the end card. Export goes back into the same review.

cost.title: Cost before it runs
cost.body: Each creative shows its estimate. Set a monthly cap per client; past it, nothing generates.

agency.title: Every client in one place, and they approve their own ads.

points.d: Its own Brain, Library and spend cap. Switch clients from the sidebar.
The Clients page shows which ads and batches need a decision.
Invite people as admin or member.
Invite the client to approve or reject ads. They can't spend or change settings.

soon.title: Not built yet. We say so.
soon.sub: These show up in the app as Coming soon too. Nothing here is counted, charged or faked.

items.d: Upload approved ads to the ad account and read results every day. Needs the Meta connection.
Each client's Meta results by campaign and ad, matched to the file names.
Reads the results and tells you what to make next, as proposals you approve.
Two more variation types for a winner: same footage in a new layout, and new scripts in the same edit.

final.title: Bring the ad that's working.
final.sub: Create an account, set up your first client, then make the first batch or the first concept.

new.uploadingNote: The analysis starts by itself when the upload finishes.
new.offerLabel: Which offer is this ad for?
new.offerHelp: The offer sets the language of the file names and which Brain the AI reads.
new.libEmpty: No winners yet. Mark your best ads with the star in the Library.
new.metaSoon: Pick your best ads straight from Meta.
new.hintUploading: Uploading. The analysis starts by itself.

analyze.readyTitle: {n, plural, one {# new piece from this ad} other {# new pieces from this ad}}
analyze.cuts: {n, plural, =0 {1 shot} one {# cut} other {# cuts}}
analyze.blocksFound: Blocks the AI found · highlighted = kept in every piece
analyze.readFrom: Read from the video and {client}'s Brain.
analyze.planTitle: The batch · {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}}
analyze.planSub: Each piece changes one thing. Its file name says what.
analyze.stretchSub: Same concept, fresh edit. Meta reads these as the same ad.
analyze.newAudienceSub: Different first frame and layout. Meta reads these as new ads.
analyze.formatsLine: Every piece comes in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1. Formats don't count as variations.
analyze.nothingNew: Everything here is edited from your video. Nothing new is generated.
analyze.generateN: Generate {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}}
analyze.hintAnalyzing: Generate unlocks when the plan is ready.
analyze.canClose: You can close this page. The plan waits for you in Home › Waiting for you.
analyze.brainEmptyTitle: {client}'s Brain is empty, so this read comes from the video alone.
analyze.brainEmptyBody: Without the product page and reviews, the pieces that use them were swapped for ones that don't need them. Fill the Brain and the next batch gets sharper.
analyze.pageMissingTitle: The product page didn't open for our browser, so the split layout was swapped for a story frame.
analyze.pageMissingBody: Add a product photo in Brain › Business & offer and the next batch can use it instead.
analyze.shortTitle: {dur} and one continuous shot, so there are no blocks to cut, reorder or open on.
analyze.shortBody: The plan uses on-screen text, layouts and a static instead: {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}}.
analyze.smallTitle: Smaller batch: {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} instead of 8 to 12.
analyze.smallBody: Each piece still changes only one thing. We don't fill the batch with pieces that make no sense.

err.MEDIA_INVALID: The file stops playing at {decoded} of {duration}.
err.MEDIA_INVALID_body: Without the rest we can't see the proof or the CTA, so there is nothing to plan from. Export it again from your editor and upload the new file.
err.MEDIA_TOO_SHORT: The video is {dur} long. It needs at least {min}.
err.MEDIA_TOO_SHORT_body: Upload a longer cut of the ad.
err.PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI service returned an error.
err.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The AI service took too long to answer.
err.RATE_LIMITED: The AI service is busy right now.
err.PLAN_INVALID: The plan didn't pass the batch rules twice.
err.retry_body: What already finished is kept. Try again to finish.
err.fallback: Something went wrong while reading the video.

analyze.charged: {usd} was charged for the steps that finished.
analyze.hintFailed: Upload a complete file to continue.
analyze.planChanged: The plan changed while you were looking. Check the new count and press Generate again.

generate.failedManyTitle: {count} pieces failed. The others keep going.
generate.failedBody: Retry runs only this piece. Rendering costs nothing, so a retry costs nothing.
generate.doneBody: Preview them, then download the zip.
generate.canClose: You can close this page. The batch keeps rendering and shows up in Home › Waiting for you.
generate.hintRunning: Download unlocks when all pieces are done. Ready ones can be previewed now.
generate.hintFailed: You can download now; the failed piece stays out unless you retry it.

err.PAGE_FORBIDDEN: The product page didn't load: the site blocked our browser.
err.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The original video is no longer in storage. Contact support.
err.photoHint: Retry with the product photo from the Brain, or leave this piece out.
err.retryHint: Retry this piece, or leave it out.

download.title: {n, plural, one {# piece, ready to upload} other {# pieces, ready to upload}}
download.lede: Two folders, because they go to different places in Ads Manager. Every file name says what changed.
download.stretchHead: A test ad set for this same concept
download.stretchBody: Keep it apart from the winner's ad set, which stays running. New ads in the winner's set barely get delivery. When one beats the winner, move it to the main set.
download.newBody: These look different to Meta, so they can find people the winner doesn't reach. One ad set, all {n} together.
download.formatsNote: Each piece: 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1 in the same folder.
download.zipFailed: The zip didn't build. Try again.
download.downloadedBody: All {n} are in the Library as variations of “{name}”.
download.notInGrid: {n, plural, one {# piece isn't here: it failed or was left out.} other {# pieces aren't here: they failed or were left out.}}
download.stillRendering: {n, plural, one {# piece is still rendering. It joins the grid when ready.} other {# pieces are still rendering. They join the grid when ready.}}
download.nothingToZip: Put at least one piece in the zip.
